## 📌 Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
Provide a clear, concise description of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

---

### 🔍 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality or new role)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (code cleanup, performance optimization, typing improvements)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX styling or responsive adjustment
- [ ] 🌐 Internationalization / translation update

---

### 🧪 Verification & Testing
- [ ] Ran `npm run build` locally with **0 TypeScript and Vite errors**.
- [ ] Tested responsive layout on Mobile and Desktop viewports.
- [ ] Tested both Dark and Light themes.
- [ ] Verified Supabase Realtime synchronization and event logging.

---

### 📸 Screenshots / Demos (If Applicable)
*Attach screenshots or recordings demonstrating UI adjustments or new features.*

---

### 📋 Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and TypeScript standards.
- [ ] All comments and documentation are written in English.
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
